help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using the AmeThyst Digital Library, from creating your account to borrowing books and joining study groups.

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body:
Create a free account with your email address on the Sign Up page. You will receive a verification email - click the link inside to activate your account before signing in.
If you forget your password, use the Forgot Password option on the Sign In page to request a secure reset link.

sections.heading: Browsing & Searching the Library
sections.body:
Browse the full catalog on the Library page, or search by title, author, publisher, or ISBN with Standard Search. Semantic Search understands concepts and topics, helping you find books even when you do not remember the exact title.
Use the filter panel to narrow results by genre, branch, availability, and publication year.

sections.heading: Reserving & Borrowing Books
sections.body:
When you find an available copy at a branch, sign in and choose Reserve for Pickup. Your reservation is confirmed with a 6-digit pickup PIN that you share with the librarian at the circulation desk.
Collect your book before the PIN expires. Borrowed books are due 14 days after pickup.

sections.heading: Returning Books & Fees
sections.body:
To return a book, generate a Return PIN from your Borrowed Books dashboard and show it to the librarian. The book condition is inspected during the return.
Overdue, damaged, or lost books may incur fees according to the library policy. You can review and pay outstanding fees from the Fees page in your dashboard.

sections.heading: Study Groups
sections.body:
Use Study Together to create or join study groups. Hosts can invite members by email, approve requests, and manage capacity.
You can cancel a pending membership request or leave a group at any time from your Study Groups dashboard.

sections.heading: Study Spaces & Rooms
sections.body: Reserve study rooms through the room dashboard and check in with your Room PIN when you arrive. Live availability and reservations are also shown on the Library Map.

sections.heading: Account & Profile
sections.body: Update your personal details, change your password, and manage your avatar from the Profile page. Keep your contact information up to date so the library can reach you about reservations and fees.

sections.heading: Contact Support
sections.body: Still stuck? Contact the library support team at support@amethyst-library.com. We usually respond within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How the AmeThyst Digital Library collects, uses, and protects your information.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body:
We collect the information you provide when creating an account, including your name, email address, phone number, and gender. You may also add a profile picture.
While you use the library, we record your borrowing history, reservations, fees, and study group activity so we can deliver our services.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
Your information is used to run the library: authenticate your account, process reservations and borrowings, calculate fees, send notifications, and personalize recommendations.
We use aggregated and anonymized data to improve search results and library operations.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. Limited data is shared with librarians to fulfill services such as pickup verification and returns, and with service providers who help operate the platform under strict confidentiality agreements.

sections.heading: Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body: We use browser local storage to remember your language and theme preferences and to keep you signed in during your session. You can clear this data at any time from your browser settings.

sections.heading: Data Retention & Security
sections.body:
We retain your account and activity records while your account is active and as required by law. We use encryption, access controls, and role-based permissions to protect your data.
Borrowing and fee records are kept according to library policy.

sections.heading: Your Rights & Choices
sections.body:
You may access, correct, or update your profile at any time, and you can request account deletion by contacting support.
You may opt out of non-essential communications while still receiving important account notices.

sections.heading: Changes & Contact
sections.body:
We may update this policy from time to time and will announce significant changes on the platform.
Questions about privacy? Contact us at support@amethyst-library.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules that govern your use of the AmeThyst Digital Library.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using the AmeThyst Digital Library, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.heading: Accounts & Eligibility
sections.body:
You must provide accurate information when creating an account and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
The library serves students and community members of AmeThyst. Accounts may be suspended for misuse.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body:
You agree not to misuse the platform, including attempting to access other users' accounts, disrupting services, or using the library for unlawful purposes.
Please follow the instructions of library staff and respect library property.

sections.heading: Library Services & Borrowing
sections.body:
Reservations and borrowings depend on availability and branch policy. Present your pickup PIN to collect a book and your return PIN to return it.
Borrowed books must be returned by the due date. Late, damaged, or lost materials may result in fees.

sections.heading: Fees & Payments
sections.body:
Fees for overdue, damaged, or lost materials are calculated under the library's published policy and must be settled before further borrowing.
If you believe a fee is incorrect, raise the issue with library staff promptly.

sections.heading: Study Groups & Community
sections.body: Study groups are user-created spaces. Hosts manage their groups, and members must behave respectfully. The library may remove groups that violate these terms.
